ideas.pitch: A real-time student sentiment and academic grievance routing system utilizing lightweight NLP to categorize department feedback and automatically prioritize urgent facility or academic concerns for GNIT administration.
ideas.title: CampusPulse GNIT

ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an immediate, relatable infrastructural pain point for an on-campus venue like GNIT within a tight 8-hour sprint.
